name: @bossnyumba/blind-review
description: Blind-review indistinguishability panel for marginal real-estate decisions (lease / rent / deposit). Anonymize -> shuffle -> N-reviewer Turing-style panel where senior property managers blind-classify each anonymised rationale as AI-authored (Mr. Mwikila) or human-authored, with an accuracy <= 0.55 indistinguishability bar. Pure functions + injected ports (decision store, ground-truth resolver, decision fetcher, audit sink, clock) — no direct DB/SDK/env. Default-OFF feature flag with a single wireBlindReview() composition export. Deterministic seeds for replayable CI runs.
